sourceTitle: 2026中国大学生方程式系列赛事规则（答题版）
measurementSetup: Wheels straight ahead; no driver. Source figure and vehicle datums require separate geometric review.
enforcement: Advisory source mapping only; scalar evaluator cannot enforce spatial zones or full competition compliance. No supplied CAD or DOCX is redistributed.

clauses.summary: Wheel visibility and exclusion regions; longitudinal exclusion extends 75 mm before and behind each tire, between its inner and outer side planes.
Reachable bodywork edges need at least 1 mm radius. Aero-specific forward edges have stricter limits.
Forward facing reachable aero horizontal edges need radius at least 5 mm and vertical edges at least 3 mm.
clauses.engine: requires edge classification and native curvature measurement; not implemented

clauses.summary: Measure with wheels straight and without driver.
Headrest reference and floor exception require direct source/figure review; do not infer position from a feature name.
Front extension at most 700 mm ahead of front tire; rear extension at most 250 mm behind rear tire.
Ahead of front axle: front tire outer planes. Between axles: line between front/rear tire outer planes. Behind rear axle: rear tire inner planes.
Height caps 500 mm ahead of headrest plane, 1200 mm behind; ahead of front axle and outside front tire inner planes cap 250 mm.
Specified fixed bodywork between axles and within 400 mm either side of centreline has a height exception; do not apply to all aero automatically.
Mount stiffness and approximately 200 N deformation checks excluded from this task.
